class.name: CompressorListItem
class.brief_description: A single position of the compressor programmer table (CompressorList).
class.description: Each [CompressorListItem] corresponds to one position of the [code]CompressorList[/code] table. This section is not documented on the FIZ wiki (https://wiki.eu07.pl/index.php/Plik_charakterystyki) - its meaning is taken from the [code]TCompressorList[/code] enum and its usages in [code]MOVER.h[/code]/[code]Mover.cpp[/code]. Items are indexed in order, starting at position 1 (position 0 is reserved/hardcoded by the mover).

members.member: [code]CompressorList:A[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Compressor run permission for this position: [code]0[/code] leaves the current permission unchanged, [code]1[/code] disallows the compressor, [code]2[/code] allows it.
[code]CompressorList:D[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Multiplier applied to the compressor cut-out (maximum) pressure threshold for this position.
[code]CompressorList:C[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Multiplier applied to the compressor cut-in (minimum) pressure threshold for this position.
[code]CompressorList:B[/code] (undocumented on the wiki) Multiplier applied to the compressor's flow rate for this position.
